card.name: Words just before dose increments
card.fires_on: The word just before the expected word "increments" in dosing text, such as a unit after a step size or "in" after adjust or titrate.

modes.label: Unit after step size
modes.description: A unit or number piece after a step size, right before "increments".
modes.example: Rasuvo is only available in doses between 7.5 to 30 mg in 2.5<< mg>> increments.

modes.label: "in" after adjust or titrate
modes.description: The word "in" after a verb of changing the dose, leading into "increments of".
modes.example: Dosage may be adjusted<< in>> increments of 10 mg or

modes.label: Decimal point in volume steps
modes.description: The decimal point in a rounding or step size like 0.1 mL.
modes.example: rounding up the volume to the nearest 0<<.>>1 mL.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "increments" or "increment" next, including Chinese words for interval.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before "increments" when a label says a dose changes in set steps.
